stories.title: Define proximity score schema and contract
stories.description: Create Pydantic models and internal schema for clinical trial proximity including distance_miles, duration_minutes, normalized_score (0-100), and metadata (route_source, timestamp). Ensure compatibility with existing clinical trials models.

stories.title: Implement proximity scoring logic
stories.description: Extend clinical_trials_service to compute proximity scores using Google Routes distance and duration. Define scoring function (e.g., inverse weighting of distance and travel time) and normalize across trials in a result set.

stories.title: Expose proximity scores via EvaluateCare facade
stories.description: Update evaluate_care_facade to include proximity scores in clinical trial responses and ensure tool_router can return enriched trial objects to the frontend.

stories.title: Unit and integration tests for proximity scoring
stories.description: Add tests validating distance/duration ingestion, scoring normalization, and API response structure. Include edge cases (missing location, zero distance, long-distance outliers).
